title: Vallee's The Invisible College

plain: The Invisible College, a book by the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée published in 1975, is still "the tip of the spear now, in terms of theory on UFOs," according to Michels. He says this himself while interviewing a guest, pointing readers to the book. His point is that thinking from nearly fifty years ago is still ahead of today's ideas on the subject.
